features: Third-party cameras supported through ONVIF Profile S
Motion detection by Essential or Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA), camera, or Motion+
Separate internet and IP camera networks
notes: Camera inputs: 16 analog + 16 IP, or 32 IP when no analog cameras are connected.
Audio inputs: 4 line inputs plus 1 microphone input (RCA).
Alarm outputs: 5 relay outputs and 1 open-collector output.
Datasheet connector list gives 6 alarm inputs; specification table gives 16. Alarm input count left out.
Datasheet allows up to 128 user accounts and advises at most 4 simultaneous connections; more connections can limit performance.
Weight excludes HDDs and DVD writer.
dimensions_mm: 440 x 408 x 76 (W x D x H)
